content.title: How to watch Yankees vs. Mariners: TV channel and streaming options for April 1
content.text: The New York Yankees and Seattle Mariners meet on Wednesday at 4:10 p.m. ET at T-Mobile Park, attempting to break a 1-1 series tie.
